Salem Custom Screen Printing is a small, faith-driven business creating custom apparel for individuals, churches, events, and youth camps. Every shirt we print carries more than ink — it carries a message. Whether it’s a fundraiser, a camp tee, or a gift, we’re here to help you share what matters most.

This website doubles as my personal development project — I’m continuously building new features, refining the look, and expanding functionality, so it can serve as a live showcase of my skills. To see more of my work — R, data science, data visualization, and other technical projects — visit my Personal Portfolio. The full source for this site is also open on GitHub.
